age_limit.details: Age relaxation is admissible as per ICMR/Government of India guidelines. For SC/ST/OBC candidates it applies only to posts reserved for the respective category, not to unreserved posts. For Ex-servicemen/Departmental candidates, including project staff, it applies as per Government of India/ICMR norms.

qualification.details: Multiple publications in MEDLINE/PubMed-indexed journals in the relevant area; journals should be listed in the Science Citation Index (SCI). Prior experience in community-based studies or excellent data analysis skills. Demonstrated ability to design and execute independent research studies and/or policy-oriented work. how_to_apply: Submit the online application form through the Google Form link given in the notice by 29 November 2026, 5:00 PM.
Submit a separate application for each position.
Report at the Department of Community & Family Medicine, Academic Block (MNC building), AIIMS, Gorakhpur on 30 November 2026 at 9:00 AM.
Bring a printed copy of the submitted application form, a recent passport-sized photograph and all original certificates for verification.
Bring the detailed bio-data/CV and one set of self-attested copies of the supporting documents.

The notice also prints an application format with 15 columns, including post applied for, email ID and mobile number, parents' names, addresses, date of birth, category, educational qualification from 10th onwards, work experience, research skills, proficiency in statistical software and the joining period required. Its general instructions ask for all columns to be filled, with "N/A" where there is nothing to enter, in block capitals, and signed with a thumb impression in the specified area.
Photo identity proof (Aadhar card/Driving Licence/Voter ID card/PAN card/Passport)*
Address proof (Aadhar card/Driving Licence/Voter ID card/PAN Card/Passport)
Proof of date of birth (10th Certificate/Birth certificate)*
Category certificate (for OBC candidates, the non-creamy layer certificate must be issued within the last one year)
Relevant marksheets and certificates*; 10th and 12th marksheet and certificate; qualifying degree/certificate
Experience certificate clearly showing date of joining and date of relieving*
List of publications, with one original copy (if any)*; GATE/NET clearance certificate (if any)*
Items marked * need one set of self-attested photocopies. The notice states that no photocopy facility is available at the institute.
important_instructions: No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview/written test/personal discussion. Candidates make their own arrangements for travel, transport and accommodation. No request for change of the interview/written test/personal discussion date will be entertained. Incomplete, late, delayed, unsigned applications, or applications without the latest photograph or required documents, will be summarily rejected without any correspondence. Incorrect, false or misleading information at any stage leads to disqualification. Canvassing or bringing influence, directly or indirectly, leads to disqualification and debarment from the selection process. The number of posts may vary. AIIMS Gorakhpur reserves the right to cancel, modify, withdraw, or not fill any or all advertised positions at any stage without assigning any reason. Selected candidates will normally be posted at the study/project site but may be posted or deputed to any other site as per project requirement. Selected candidates must join within 15 days from the declaration of result/issue of offer letter, failing which the offer may be cancelled, and must complete project formalities such as signing the declaration, offer letter, code of conduct and confidentiality undertaking.

Project period 01/02/2025 – 31/01/2028; selected candidates will normally be engaged for 11 months or less
Online application form, then walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: About the Project and the Institute
content_sections.text: AIIMS Gorakhpur is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. The post sits in an ongoing ICMR-funded extramural project run by the Department of Community Medicine & Family Medicine, with Dr. U Venkatesh, Assistant Professor, as Principal Investigator. The project evaluates the ICMR-NCTB Mudra Toolbox and Cognitive Harmony Program on cognitive health at Ayushman Arogya Mandir.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one post, Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), with 1 vacancy. The essential and desirable conditions are as follows. Maximum age limit: 40 years, counted as on the last date of application. Willingness and ability to travel extensively for field-related tasks on a regular basis is mandatory. Experience is counted from the date of completion of the minimum essential educational qualification. Candidates already working against regular/permanent posts under Government departments/organizations are not eligible to apply. Candidates already employed must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of interview/written test/personal discussion, failing which they may not be allowed to appear. Multiple publications in MEDLINE/PubMed-indexed journals in the relevant area; journals should be listed in the Science Citation Index (SCI). Prior experience in community-based studies or excellent data analysis skills. Demonstrated ability to design and execute independent research studies and/or policy-oriented work. Ability to work in a diverse, interdisciplinary research environment and provide technical guidance to other team members. Age relaxation is admissible as per ICMR/Government of India guidelines. For SC/ST/OBC candidates it applies only to posts reserved for the respective category, not to unreserved posts. For Ex-servicemen/Departmental candidates, including project staff, it applies as per Government of India/ICMR norms.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Public Health / Biostatistics / Population Studies / Health Geography, or other relevant disciplines, from a recognized university, with three years of research experience in a relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly emoluments are ₹67,000 + 20% HRA = ₹80,400. The rates of emoluments/stipend may vary as per the sanction of the funding agency and applicable guidelines. The engagement is governed by the applicable guidelines of the ICMR Extramural Research Grant and the rules/instructions issued from time to time. The position is purely temporary and contractual, and co-terminus with the project. It gives no right to claim regular appointment, absorption, continuation or transfer to any post in AIIMS Gorakhpur, ICMR, the funding agency or any other Government organization. Selected candidates will normally be engaged for 11 months or less, depending on the project tenure, availability of funds, functional requirements and approval of the competent authority. Continuation or extension is subject to satisfactory performance, project requirement, availability of funds, project tenure and approval of the competent authority. No Provident Fund, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim or other regular service benefits are admissible. Leave applies as per ICMR guidelines/project rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Submit the online application form through the Google Form link given in the notice by 29 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Submit a separate application for each position. Report at the Department of Community & Family Medicine, Academic Block (MNC building), AIIMS, Gorakhpur on 30 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. Bring a printed copy of the submitted application form, a recent passport-sized photograph and all original certificates for verification. Bring the detailed bio-data/CV and one set of self-attested copies of the supporting documents. The notice also prints an application format with 15 columns, including post applied for, email ID and mobile number, parents' names, addresses, date of birth, category, educational qualification from 10th onwards, work experience, research skills, proficiency in statistical software and the joining period required. Its general instructions ask for all columns to be filled, with "N/A" where there is nothing to enter, in block capitals, and signed with a thumb impression in the specified area. Filled application format Photo identity proof (Aadhar card/Driving Licence/Voter ID card/PAN card/Passport)* Address proof (Aadhar card/Driving Licence/Voter ID card/PAN Card/Passport) Proof of date of birth (10th Certificate/Birth certificate)* Recent passport size photographs (two) Category certificate (for OBC candidates, the non-creamy layer certificate must be issued within the last one year) Relevant marksheets and certificates*; 10th and 12th marksheet and certificate; qualifying degree/certificate Experience certificate clearly showing date of joining and date of relieving* List of publications, with one original copy (if any)*; GATE/NET clearance certificate (if any)* Items marked * need one set of self-attested photocopies. The notice states that no photocopy facility is available at the institute.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview at the Department of Community & Family Medicine, Academic Block (MNC building), AIIMS, Gorakhpur, on 30 November 2026 at 9:00 AM (Monday). Only eligible candidates will be permitted to appear for the interview after document verification. A candidate found not suitable in document verification will not be allowed to appear in the personal interview. If the number of eligible candidates is large, a written examination may be conducted before the interview. In case of a large number of eligible candidates, the appointing authority may adopt suitable higher criteria for shortlisting for the interview/written test/personal discussion. Meeting the essential qualification and experience does not guarantee shortlisting or selection. The decision of the Screening Committee/Interview Committee/competent authority is final and binding.
